claim: HOIL-1 (encoded by the RBCK1 gene), HOIP (RNF31) and SHARPIN form the linear ubiquitin chain assembly complex (LUBAC).
source: HOIL-1 (encoded by the RBCK1 gene), HOIP (RNF31) and SHARPIN form the linear ubiquitin chain assembly complex (LUBAC), which linearly ubiquitinates receptor signaling complex components such as NEMO to enhance NF-κB activation after engagement of immune receptors including TNF-R1, IL-1R, CD40, TLRs and NOD2 (Tokunaga et al., 2011; Tokunaga et al., 2009; Ikeda et al., 2011; Gerlach et al., 2011; Haas et al., 2009; Zak et al., 2011; Hostager et al., 2011; Boisson et al., 2012; Damgaard et al., 2012; Tian et al., 2007).
evidence: Supported by multiple citations to prior research establishing the composition of LUBAC

claim: LUBAC linearly ubiquitinates receptor signaling complex components such as NEMO to enhance NF-κB activation after engagement of immune receptors including TNF-R1, IL-1R, CD40, TLRs and NOD2.

evidence: Supported by multiple citations to prior research on LUBAC function

source: Recently, HOIL-1/LUBAC was also shown to be important for activation of the NLRP3/ASC inflammasome in macrophages via linear ubiquitination of ASC (Rodgers et al., 2014).
evidence: Supported by citation to Rodgers et al., 2014
